facts.fact: Inside Biz reports the Central Bank of Eswatini's own e-procurement system, where suppliers register and compete for tenders online, went live on the day of its unveiling at the 2025 CBE Supplier Day; it covers the Bank's purchasing only.
Inside Biz reports the Central Bank of Eswatini's e-procurement system was developed in-house by the Bank's Information Technology Division and went live at its 2025 Supplier Day.
